import numpy as np
from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find 4-connected components of 1s.
    cid=[[-1]*w for _ in range(h)]; comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=1 or cid[r][c]>=0: continue
            k=len(comps); q=[(r,c)]; cid[r][c]=k; cells=[]
            for y,x in q:
                cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==1 and cid[yy][xx]<0:
                        cid[yy][xx]=k; q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(cells)
    # Label zero-components and mark those not connected to the edge.
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; zero_comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=0 or seen[r][c]: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]; edge=False; adj=set()
            for y,x in q:
                cells.append((y,x)); edge |= y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w:
                        if grid[yy][xx]==0 and not seen[yy][xx]: seen[yy][xx]=True; q.append((yy,xx))
                        elif grid[yy][xx]==1: adj.add(cid[yy][xx])
            zero_comps.append((cells,edge,adj))
    closed_components=set()
    enclosed=[]
    for cells,edge,adj in zero_comps:
        if not edge:
            enclosed.append(cells); closed_components.update(adj)
            # Color interior except its deepest medial core.
            dist={p:0 for p in cells if any(0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and grid[y][x]==1 for y,x in ((p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]-1),(p[0],p[1]+1)))}
            qq=deque(dist)
            while qq:
                y,x=qq.popleft()
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if (yy,xx) in cells and (yy,xx) not in dist:
                        dist[(yy,xx)]=dist[(y,x)]+1; qq.append((yy,xx))
            md=max(dist.values()) if dist else 0
            for p in cells:
                out[p[0]][p[1]]=0 if dist.get(p,0)==md else 3
    # Fill a one-cell halo around every 1-component that forms an enclosure.
    for k in closed_components:
        cells=comps[k]
        r0=max(0,min(r for r,c in cells)-1); r1=min(h-1,max(r for r,c in cells)+1)
        c0=max(0,min(c for r,c in cells)-1); c1=min(w-1,max(c for r,c in cells)+1)
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                if grid[r][c]==0 and out[r][c]!=3 and not any((r,c) in cc for cc in enclosed):
                    out[r][c]=2
    return out
